title: senna roemeriana
intro: Senna roemeriana, commonly known as Mexican buckthorn or Texas buckthorn, is a flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to treat constipation and other digestive issues due to its laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna roemeriana can be attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which stimulate bowel movements and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Senna roemeriana include anthraquinone glycosides, such as sennosides A and B, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
